title: Open the Corner
setup: Black's king hides on h8 behind its own rook and pawns, with only the h7 pawn between it and your rook.
hint: The king has no legal move at all. What capture forces it onto the one square you can reach?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxh7+}} is a rook for a pawn, and {{Kxh7}} is Black's only move. Dragged onto h7 the king is stuck against its own rook and pawn, and {{Qh5#}} lands from a distance. The rook was never the target. The square h7 was.
